children: AstraZeneca investors might shift focus to the company's outlook for next year after it reported better-than-expected results for the third quarter and left its full-year guidance unchanged, Bank of America analysts say in a research note. Investors are debating the U.K. drugmaker's profitability outlook for next year, the analysts say. Bank of America expects AstraZeneca to guide for sales growth in the mid-to-high single-digit percentage range in 2027, with core EPS in the low double-digit range. Shares in AstraZeneca have been down after drug pipeline setbacks and merger speculation, so the company will need to deliver positive clinical-trial results to rebut investors' fears and has a busy 2027 ahead, the analysts add. Shares rise 5.2%. (adria.calatayud@wsj.com)
